# ZERO-TEST-TOUCH AND NEW-TEST-ONLY RESULTS — META-380

**Issue:** Linear META-380 · **Preregistration:** `5ccb7ff6dd7a59a276aa3d6aa372f3df3bf1505d` (binding) · **Pre-outcome freeze:** `04557b2e3f33636e53fbfc5d7bd857315960083f`

Every one of the 1000 evaluation transactions is classified into exactly one of
three classes (§20) and **all are retained**. No transaction was dropped because
no test was touched, because only a newly created test was touched, because H
abstained, because B2 was non-distinctive, or because the result was inconvenient.

```
POSITIVE        |G(q)| >= 1
NEW_TEST_ONLY   |G(q)| == 0 and T touched >= 1 test file not in Suite(T0)
ZERO_TEST_TOUCH T touched no TEST-role file at all
G(q) = { p : p touched by T and TEST(p) and p in Suite(T0) }
```

## New-test touches excluded from the recall denominator (§18)

Tests created by `T` itself are not in `Suite(T0)` and are therefore structurally
unreachable by **every** method. They are recorded separately and excluded from
the primary recall denominator.

| Repository | NEW_TEST_ONLY queries | total new-test file touches | POSITIVE queries also touching a new test |

| `solidjs/solid-start` | 20 | 93 | 17 |
| `tinymce/tinymce` | 25 | 69 | 16 |
| `tutao/tutanota` | 0 | 4 | 4 |
| `refined-github/refined-github` | 5 | 7 | 2 |

## Reading the sparsity

`ZERO_TEST_TOUCH` dominates on three of five repositories
(`solid-start` 76.5%,
`tutanota` 76.0%,
`refined-github` 91.5%).
Most source-changing transactions in these repositories touch no test file at all.
This is the outcome-side sparsity the frozen §21 informative rule and the D1 rung
of the §23 ladder were written in advance to detect. It is a **result**, not a
defect to be engineered around, and it is reported unmodified.
